tool_args.rationale: The paid probe finds positive response at H=8.47 and negative response at H=17.42 and 24.2. Together with the short-horizon rise, these observations support a fast positive response opposed by slower adaptation. Fit all four parameters on the eight paid rows and submit the model for fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five short-horizon points and three longer-horizon points already constrain the fast rise and slow reversal; another batch is not needed before confirmation.
The observed input-normalized short-horizon gains support the linear-input fast term, and all s_grad values are zero, so a sink coefficient would be unidentifiable.
The observed positive rise and later decline are consistent with one delayed reversal; there is no evidence of a recurring cycle.
It does not constrain the horizon response.
